proves.claim: With runs_store on, two offers of one program store each program text once in the runs file program table, and every offered row holds only its sha256.

api.jobs-program.offer-holds-only-the-ha.why: Without this test the runs file would again hold a full copy of the program text in every offered row.

proves.claim: A claimed job reads back the same program text it was offered with.

api.jobs-program.claimed-job-reads-the-t.why: Without this test a runner could be handed a hash instead of the program it must run.
